title: The Literary magazine of the school
subtitle: 文学写作 · 主题语境阅读
theme: 文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）
meta: 主题语境：文学写作（人与社会·文学艺术与体育·文学与写作）　|　核心词汇：literary　|　正文 341 words　|　高三一轮复习
intro: 请阅读文章，根据上下文判断每一处 literary 的用法与含义，再完成 Task 1—Task 3。
passage: In 1976 the cook wrote of ① a literary magazine of the school in the menu, and everybody in the canteen said at once that it was ② so literary that nobody in the canteen would go near it. Three days on, people still spoke of that morning, and of how the cook, who never explained anything, had done it in silence and gone home; it was the literary ones, my mother said, that people remembered longest.

It was ③ the literary magazine of the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the menu for September 1970 claims. My mother, who had seen them all, thought it ④ too literary to be of any use to anybody, and said as much to the guest who had come to help; the literary ones, she used to say, were never the useful ones.

My uncle, who kept the bowl at the far table, meant something else entirely. He called the whole business ⑤ a literary style of the letter, and said that no guest in his right mind would call it ⑥ as literary as the style of the letter they had once had in the old canteen. He was never a man who cared whether a thing was literary or not, and he said so.

By 1983 the matter had shrunk to half a line in the menu. What the line asked for was ⑦ something literary, and nothing besides. The guest from the next canteen called the whole plan ⑧ quite literary; everybody laughed, and then did exactly what he had said. After that the menu kept the names of the literary ones only.

My mother said nothing at all. In 1986, twice over, she wrote of another literary magazine of the school in the same menu, and the work, which took two days, seemed ⑨ no less literary than anybody had expected. ⑩ The literary style of the letter that nobody had wanted to name, she said in 1988, was the one she could never quite name; the literary ones, she added, are always the ones that stay.

task1.title: Task 1　语境辨义
task1.intro: 请为文中十处画线形式选择对应的用法说明。
options: A. adj. 文学（前置定语 a literary magazine of the school：1976 年厨子在菜单里记下的那件文学的刊物）
B. adj. 文学／书卷气（两处加强说法：so literary that … 与 no less literary than …）
C. adj. 文学／书卷气（两处定语从句式的最高级说法，见第 3、10 题）
D. adj. 文学（表语 too literary to do：母亲觉得它太文学，反倒派不上用场）
E. adj. 书卷气（前置定语 a literary style of the letter：叔叔把整件事称作一桩书卷气的文风）
F. adj. 书卷气（同级比较 as literary as：拿眼前这桩跟旧日那桩信里书卷气的文风相比）
G. adj. 书卷气（后置定语 something literary：修饰不定代词时须放在其后）
H. adj. 书卷气（受程度副词修饰 quite literary：那位客人的评价）

items.q: a literary magazine of the school
the literary magazine of the school that
a literary style of the letter
The literary style of the letter that

answers.why: literary 意为“文学”，1976 年厨子在菜单里记下的是“一件文学的刊物”，此处作前置定语 a literary magazine of the school。
literary 意为“文学”，此处用 so literary that 结构，说它文学到食堂里没人敢靠近。
literary 意为“文学”，菜单上 九月 那行字说那是当地人从未见过的文学学校的文学刊物，等于最高级的说法。
literary 意为“文学”，母亲认为这件东西“太文学了，谁也用不上”，too literary to do 表示“太……以致不能”。
literary 意为“书卷气”，叔叔把整件事称作“一桩书卷气的文风”，此处作前置定语 a literary style of the letter。
literary 意为“书卷气”，叔叔不肯说它“跟旧日那桩信里书卷气的文风一样书卷气”，同级比较用 as literary as。
literary 意为“书卷气”，菜单上那半行字要的是“书卷气的东西”，something 被形容词修饰时形容词须后置：something literary。
literary 意为“书卷气”，邻食堂来的那位客人认为这套计划“相当书卷气”，quite 修饰原级 literary。
literary 意为“书卷气”，no less literary than 表示“其书卷气不亚于……”，此处说这趟活儿之书卷气不亚于任何人的预料。
literary 意为“书卷气”，母亲 1988 年说的是“那桩她始终叫不出名字的书卷气文风”，that 从句限定到极致。

task2.title: Task 2　语境运用
task2.intro: 请把下列句子译成英文，括号里是必须用到的形式。
items: 1976 年，厨子在菜单里记下了一件文学的刊物。（a literary magazine of the school）
它文学到食堂里没有一个人敢靠近。（so literary that …）
母亲觉得它太文学，谁也用不上。（too literary to …）
叔叔把整件事称作一桩书卷气的文风。（a literary style of the letter）
他说，谁也不会认为它跟旧日那桩信里书卷气的文风一样书卷气。（as literary as …）
到了 1983 年，菜单上只剩半行字：要的是一件书卷气的东西。（something literary）
answers: In 1976 the cook wrote of a literary magazine of the school in the menu.
It was so literary that nobody in the canteen would go near it.
My mother thought it too literary to be of any use to anybody.
My uncle called the whole business a literary style of the letter.
He said nobody would call it as literary as the style of the letter they had once had.
By 1983 the menu asked for nothing but something literary.

task3.title: Task 3　语境写作
task3.intro: 请写 5—6 个句子，至少使用 literary 的 3 种不同用法（前置定语、表语、比较级／最高级、后置定语等）；至少使用下列词语中的 3 个。
answers: In 1976 the cook wrote of a literary magazine of the school in the menu, and nobody forgot it.
It was the literary magazine of the school that anybody there had ever seen, or so the menu says.
My mother thought it too literary to be of any use, and said so plainly.
My uncle called the whole business a literary style of the letter, and nobody argued with him.
The guest from the next canteen called the plan quite literary, and everybody laughed.
The literary ones, my mother said, are always the ones that stay.
